evidence_fusion_invariant: Foundation uses frozen repetition-free greedy decoding. ASCENT retains the complete Foundation prediction and appends only completed seven-digit runs decoded in query order from the latent state by the independently trained linear head. It cannot remove a correct Foundation value; incomplete runs are discarded.
redesign_rationale: Exact accounting invalidated the preceding 38/78/92 development schedule because persistent state is B_s*d_s elements and its middle relative footprint increased. This repair uses the largest middle integer budget compatible with a strict decrease, is fixed globally from model parameter counts, and is evaluated only on the already-development-only seed 371101.

state_budget_rule.formula: B_s = round_half_up(38 + 54 * (log(N_s/N_low)/log(N_high/N_low))^1.17), with B_low=38 at the zero-log boundary
state_budget_rule.relative_cost: (B_s*d_s)/N_s strictly decreases over every adjacent registered endpoint

primary_metric: NVIDIA RULER string_match_all gain for four ordered answers under full-context greedy plus latent evidence
development_gate: Every endpoint gain and both adjacent gain point differences must be positive, while (state tokens * hidden size) / model parameters strictly decreases at both adjacent transitions. Any successful design requires three entirely new hash-frozen confirmation seeds.
interpretation: Seed 371101 is development-only. Seeds 371202/371303 will not be promoted; any successful repair will use an entirely new confirmation panel. FPVM excluded.
